saveMigrationHints.applyOnlyWhen: A save has no activity/progression markers and Population exactly equals the old untouched starter default of 125.
saveMigrationHints.preserveRule: Preserve Population 125 or higher when the save has earned resources, completed research, built structures, manual changes, or any other sign of established play.
saveMigrationHints.notes: Population is citizen/workforce capacity, not a spendable manual-click currency. Clients should not silently reset established saves.

saveMigrationHints.applyOnlyWhen: A save does not contain selectedAiAgentId.
saveMigrationHints.preserveRule: If a save contains an unknown selectedAiAgentId, clients should render the default AI Agent while preserving the unresolved value for diagnostics.
saveMigrationHints.notes: AI Agent is a cosmetic/presentation companion layer over the existing automation system.

saveMigrationHints.applyOnlyWhen: A save does not contain selectedAiAgentVariantId.
saveMigrationHints.preserveRule: If a save contains an unknown selectedAiAgentVariantId, clients should render the default variant while preserving the unresolved value for diagnostics.
saveMigrationHints.notes: AI Agent variant selection is cosmetic only. Automation upgrade levels remain the source of Labor Assistance strength.

saveMigrationHints.applyOnlyWhen: A save or authored reference contains an AI ID from Volumes 1 through 5 using the schema 1.1.0 catalog.
saveMigrationHints.preserveRule: Resolve the former ID through the exported migration map by matching its canonical volume and library index; preserve unknown IDs for diagnostics.
saveMigrationHints.notes: Pack A schema 1.2.0 rebuilds Volumes 1 through 5. The migration map prevents existing AI selections and references from being silently discarded.

saveMigrationHints.applyOnlyWhen: A save or authored reference contains an AI ID from Volumes 6 through 10 using the schema 1.1.0 catalog.
saveMigrationHints.preserveRule: Resolve the former ID through the exported migration map by matching its canonical volume and library index; preserve unknown IDs for diagnostics.
saveMigrationHints.notes: Pack B schema 1.2.0 rebuilds Volumes 6 through 10. The shared migration export covers all legacy Pack A and B IDs.

saveMigrationHints.applyOnlyWhen: A client loads contentVersion 44 or later and does not yet contain AI Library Volumes 11 through 20.
saveMigrationHints.preserveRule: Preserve all owned and selected Pack A/B AI IDs. Add Packs C/D as unowned collectible definitions without changing the active companion.
saveMigrationHints.notes: AI Library v2 expands the canonical collection to 2,000 companions across 20 volumes while preserving the one-active-AI rule.

saveMigrationHints.applyOnlyWhen: A client loads contentVersion 45 or later.
saveMigrationHints.preserveRule: Keep the published ai_v11 stable IDs. Resolve supplied AI-XI-001 through AI-XI-020 IDs as aliases and preserve player ownership or selection.
saveMigrationHints.notes: The first twenty Terraforming Initiative companions now use the authored Volume XI identities.

saveMigrationHints.preserveRule: Keep the published ai_v11 stable IDs. Resolve supplied AI-XI-021 through AI-XI-040 IDs as aliases and preserve player ownership or selection.
saveMigrationHints.notes: The second twenty Terraforming Initiative companions now use the authored Volume XI identities.

saveMigrationHints.notes: The third twenty Terraforming Initiative companions now use the authored Volume XI identities.

saveMigrationHints.preserveRule: Keep the published ai_v11 stable IDs. Resolve supplied AI-XI-061 through AI-XI-080 IDs as aliases and preserve player ownership or selection.

saveMigrationHints.notes: The first twenty Education & Knowledge companions now use the authored Volume XII identities.

saveMigrationHints.applyOnlyWhen: A client loads contentVersion 51 or later and a canonical universe object does not yet have a visual signature.
saveMigrationHints.preserveRule: Preserve every canonical universe, galaxy, sector, and star-system ID. Derive visual identity on demand from the existing universe seed, generation version, semantic level, and canonical object ID.
saveMigrationHints.notes: Visual signature migration changes presentation metadata only. It must never regenerate topology or materialize the full universe.

saveMigrationHints.applyOnlyWhen: A client loads contentVersion 52 or later and supports Studio-authored star-system background derivatives.
saveMigrationHints.preserveRule: Preserve star-system IDs and runtime visual signatures. Use published background derivatives when present; otherwise fall back to deterministic procedural atlas rendering.
saveMigrationHints.notes: PSD sources remain private Studio authoring files and are never consumed by game clients.

saveMigrationHints.applyOnlyWhen: A client loads contentVersion 56 or later and consumes canonical Sol body data.
saveMigrationHints.preserveRule: Preserve all existing Sol body IDs, parent links, discovery attribution, authored history, and player state. Replace only unlocked generated scientific fields with source-backed canonical overrides.
saveMigrationHints.notes: Adds the five recognized dwarf planets, source metadata, completeness, knowledge modes, active-environment rules, and locked scientific overrides without creating parallel Planet Types or Resources.
